findings.statement: Sorting the key index across threads speeds up the sort
findings.detail: sort 0.0099s parallel against 0.0121s sequential (sequential vs parallel: greater 1.224x (p=0.0202, rel_iqr 9.9%/19.2%))

findings.statement: That speed-up is visible in the load it is part of
findings.detail: 963094 ops/s parallel against 990076 sequential (parallel vs sequential: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 0.973, p=0.6761) -- within noise, not a result). f31 put the ceiling at 7% for the sort alone before this was written, which is the point of measuring it: a change whose best case is single digits has to clear the noise of the thing it is embedded in, and that is a different question from whether the sort got faster

notes: both arms interleaved; the only difference is Options::parallel_index
